changelog.body:
## Changes

- Restored rewarded games and story/reel actions on Facebook 587.
- Reduced background-process overhead and duplicate AMOLED hooks.

changelog.name: v1.24
changelog.body:
## Fixed

- **Runaway account-capture logging and preference writes** ([#16](https://github.com/Loukious/FacebookAppAdsRemover/issues/16)) — account capture now finishes and unhooks `ViewerContext.equals()` once the token and user ID are available, even when Facebook does not provide cookies.
- Captured values are saved and logged only when they change; changed fields are saved together in one preference update. Missing cookies produce a single warning.
- Queued and concurrent callbacks cannot restart completed capture. Startup retries cannot reinstall a completed account hook. Account values are omitted from update logs.

**Version:** 1.24 (`versionCode 25`).

Includes 13 new account-capture regression tests, covering absent/malformed cookies, repeated and concurrent callbacks, and persistence/unhook failures. All 111 unit tests passed. On-device verification of issue #16 is still pending.

changelog.name: v1.23
changelog.body:
## Fixed

- **Startup freezes and repeated discovery scans** — full DexKit discovery now runs off the main thread. Missing anchors are cached explicitly so later launches can use the discovery cache.
- **Discovery cache edge cases** — valid scans with no method targets are reusable, and cached methods with object-array parameters load correctly.
- **Background playback tracking** — activity tracking starts before discovery so the first visible activity is counted, with protection against duplicate registration.

**Version:** 1.23 (`versionCode 24`).

Includes [PR #17](https://github.com/Loukious/FacebookAppAdsRemover/pull/17). All 98 unit tests passed and the release APK built successfully.

changelog.name: v1.21
changelog.body:
## ⚠️ IMPORTANT — uninstall the previous module version first

**The signing certificate changed since v1.15.**

## What's new since v1.15

### Ad blocking and navigation
- Split ad blocking into **independent News Feed, Stories, Reels, Marketplace, and Games switches**, plus an optional CSR feed-ad guard. Shared hooks and the global ad-free-session spoof now respect which surfaces you actually enabled.
- Independent options to **hide Reels, Marketplace, and Games navigation tabs** without disabling those destinations; the separate hide-Reels-in-feed filter remains available.
- Removed the retired Reels shopping-card toggle/hook; the former master ads setting is migrated to the independent switches.

### Feed filtering and reliability
- Unified classic, CSR cache, late-cache, and Litho feed filtering, with improved handling of sponsored posts, AI-labeled posts, and other selected feed rules. The AI filter requires affirmative detected/self-disclosed metadata where available; unrecognized story shapes are left alone rather than broadly hiding unrelated posts.
- Improved Facebook 580 structural hook discovery, signature matching, cache invalidation, retry behavior, and diagnostic health logs.

### Media and appearance
- Added **AMOLED black mode**, keeping text, artwork, and intentional colored surfaces distinct.
- Reworked contextual Reel/Story actions with native Reel **Download** and **Repost** buttons, Story **Repost** in its menu, per-media quality selection, Copy URL for the selected quality, and browser handoff options.
- Updated the module settings UI to Material 3 / Android dynamic color where supported.

### Video resume: v1.21 fixes
- Faster, optional resume for short Reels, including saved positions around one second; better separation between manual seeking and Facebook's automatic pooled-player positioning/reset, with saved-progress protection.
- **Fixed a v1.20 regression** where repeated Reel stop/start events could re-arm the resume hook and seek to the same point about every 200 ms, creating a tiny playback loop. v1.21 limits restoration across those player restarts; a genuine later revisit can restore again.
- Video resume remains **OFF by default** for new installs. If any Reel misbehaves, disable **Resume video position** in module settings and restart Facebook.

**Compatibility:** Facebook `com.facebook.katana`, developed and tested against Facebook **580.0.0.51.74**; also based on prior 576-era structural discovery. Future Facebook updates may require new hooks; Facebook 571 and older are unsupported.

**Build:** Module v1.21 (`versionCode 22`), signed release APK. The included automated test suite passed (84 tests); this does not guarantee every Reel or feed variation is covered.

# Facebook App Ads Remover

An Xposed module that removes ads and unwanted content from the Facebook Android app, with media downloads, playback controls and account tools.

Current version: **1.26**.

## Requirements

- Android **8.1 or newer**.
- A compatible Xposed framework supporting the modern libxposed API **101 or newer**. Development testing uses Vector with API 102.
- The main Facebook app, **`com.facebook.katana`**. Facebook Lite and Messenger are not supported.

Development and device testing have covered Facebook **576.0.0.42.73**, **580.0.0.51.74** and **587.0.0.39.55**. Facebook 571 and earlier are unsupported. Facebook updates can change individual features; compatibility with arbitrary versions is not guaranteed.

The new account-capture integration was checked on Facebook 587. Startup capture was observed on device; account switching, token refresh and logout have regression-test coverage but have not been verified on device. This integration has not been verified against older Facebook APKs.

## Install

1. Download and install the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/tn.loukious.facebookappadsremover/releases).
2. Enable the module in your Xposed manager and select **Facebook** as its scope.
3. Fully close Facebook and reopen it so the module loads.
4. Open **Facebook App Ads Remover** from its launcher icon or your Xposed manager's module settings button.

Feature switches stay disabled until the settings app connects to the framework. The first Facebook launch after a module or Facebook update can take longer while features are discovered.

## Features

- **Ads:** block sponsored News Feed posts, Story and Reels ads, Marketplace promotions and Instant Games ads. Extra feed protection also covers supported cached-feed paths. Supported rewarded games can still grant rewards after an ad is skipped.
- **Feed filters:** hide Threads posts, Reels, suggestions, People You May Know, Stories blocks and detected Facebook-labeled AI content. Filter posts by keywords and optionally block automatic feed refreshes.
- **Stories:** watch without marking stories as seen, or hide the Stories tray.
- **Appearance:** force dark mode and use true-black AMOLED backgrounds. AMOLED mode requires Facebook's dark theme or Force dark mode.
- **Privacy:** allow screenshots and recording, and block Facebook's capture detection.
- **Navigation:** hide Reels, Marketplace or Gaming tabs while keeping their destinations accessible elsewhere.
- **Links:** use an external browser and optionally remove Facebook redirect tracking. Facebook pages and login flows stay in the app.
- **Media:** download the active Reel or Story, choose media quality, use a browser or the built-in downloader, and optionally trigger downloads from copied links. Repost active Reels and Stories through the Facebook Page posting flow.
- **Video:** resume playback position and optionally keep the current video playing in the background.
- **Account:** export and restore Facebook login-session files.
- **Module:** show or hide the launcher icon without disabling the module.

Ad blocking, external browsing, browser downloads and contextual download buttons default **ON**. Other optional switches default **OFF**.

Ad-family settings are independent, but methods shared by Stories and Reels may require both ad switches to be enabled. Feed-filter coverage depends on the hooks available in your Facebook version; hiding many suggestions can slow feed loading.

## Settings and Apply changes

The settings app has a home/status screen, separate feature pages, Diagnostics and About. It follows your system light/dark theme and uses wallpaper colors on Android 12 or newer.

After changing a feature setting or successfully importing a session, return home and tap **Apply changes**. The module waits for participating Facebook processes to exit before reopening Facebook. Pending changes survive closing or recreating the settings app; edits made during a restart remain pending.

If a restart cannot be confirmed, changes remain pending. Open Facebook and retry, or force-stop Facebook manually before reopening it.

## Account backups

**Export** saves Facebook's live authentication/login-session files to `Download/FacebookAppAdsRemover` as `FBAR-Session-*.json`. Separately captured tokens and cookies are not added to the export.

**Import latest** restores the newest backup. **Import from file** lets you select a backup, including one copied from another device. After a successful import, return home and tap **Apply changes**.

Backups contain login credentials and can give access to your account. Keep them private and do not attach them to issue reports.

## Diagnostics

Open Facebook before using **Save report** or **Share report**. Reports contain sanitized configuration and hook-discovery diagnostics, excluding raw activity and media payloads. Pending requests and private cached reports survive settings recreation, including while the system save picker is open.

When reporting a problem, include your Facebook version, framework version, the affected feature and a diagnostics report.

## Hide the launcher icon

The **Module** page can hide the launcher icon. You can still reopen settings from the Xposed manager's module list. Hiding the icon does not disable Facebook's hooks.

On Pixel Launcher, searching for the module can still show an App Info entry even when its drawer icon is hidden.

## Support and source

- [Report a problem or request a feature](https://github.com/Loukious/FacebookAppAdsRemover/issues)
- [Source code and technical documentation](https://github.com/Loukious/FacebookAppAdsRemover)
- [Support development](https://buymeacoffee.com/loukious)

This repository hosts the module listing and release APKs. Development source is maintained in the linked source repository.

# Facebook 应用广告去除器

Xpose 模块可从 Facebook Android 应用程序中删除广告和不需要的内容，并提供媒体下载、播放控制和帐户工具。

当前版本：**1.26**。

## 要求

- Android **8.1 或更高版本**。
- 兼容的 Xposed 框架，支持现代 libxposed API **101 或更新版本**。开发测试使用带有 API 102 的 Vector。
- 主要的 Facebook 应用程序，**`com.facebook.katana`**。不支持 Facebook Lite 和 Messenger。

开发和设备测试已覆盖 Facebook **576.0.0.42.73**、**580.0.0.51.74** 和 **587.0.0.39.55**。 Facebook 571 及更早版本不受支持。 Facebook 更新可能会改变个人功能；不保证与任意版本的兼容性。

在 Facebook 587 上检查了新的帐户捕获集成。在设备上观察到启动捕获；帐户切换、令牌刷新和注销具有回归测试覆盖范围，但尚未在设备上进行验证。此集成尚未针对旧版 Facebook APK 进行验证。

## 安装

1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/tn.lokious.facebookappadsremover/releases) 下载并安装 APK。
2. 在 Xposed 管理器中启用该模块并选择 **Facebook** 作为其范围。
3. 完全关闭 Facebook 并重新打开，以便加载模块。
4. 从启动器图标或 Xposed 管理器的模块设置按钮打开 **Facebook App Ads Remover**。

在设置应用程序连接到框架之前，功能开关将保持禁用状态。模块或 Facebook 更新后首次启动 Facebook 可能需要更长时间才能发现功能。

## 特点

- **广告：**阻止赞助的动态消息帖子、故事和卷轴广告、市场促销和即时游戏广告。额外的提要保护还涵盖支持的缓存提要路径。跳过广告后，受支持的奖励游戏仍然可以授予奖励。
- **提要过滤器：**隐藏线程帖子、卷轴、建议、您可能认识的人、故事块和检测到的 Facebook 标记的 AI 内容。按关键字过滤帖子，并可选择阻止自动提要刷新。
- **故事：**观看时不标记所看到的故事，或隐藏故事托盘。
- **外观：**强制深色模式并使用纯黑色 AMOLED 背景。 AMOLED 模式需要 Facebook 的深色主题或强制深色模式。
- **隐私：**允许截图和录制，并阻止 Facebook 的捕获检测。
- **导航：** 隐藏“卷轴”、“市场”或“游戏”选项卡，同时保持其目的地可在其他地方访问。
- **链接：** 使用外部浏览器并可选择删除 Facebook 重定向跟踪。 Facebook 页面和登录流程保留在应用程序中。
- **媒体：**下载活动卷或故事，选择媒体质量，使用浏览器或内置下载器，并可选择从复制的链接触发下载。通过 Facebook 页面发布流程重新发布活动的卷轴和故事。
- **视频：**恢复播放位置并可选择将当前视频保留在后台播放。
- **帐户：** 导出和恢复 Facebook 登录会话文件。
- **模块：** 显示或隐藏启动器图标而不禁用模块。

广告拦截、外部浏览、浏览器下载和上下文下载按钮默认**开启**。其他可选开关默认**OFF**。

广告系列设置是独立的，但故事和卷轴共享的方法可能需要启用两个广告开关。 Feed 过滤器的覆盖范围取决于您的 Facebook 版本中可用的挂钩；隐藏许多建议可能会减慢提要加载速度。

## 设置并应用更改

设置应用程序有一个主/状态屏幕、单独的功能页面、诊断和关于。它遵循您的系统浅色/深色主题，并在 Android 12 或更高版本上使用壁纸颜色。

更改功能设置或成功导入会话后，返回主页并点击 **应用更改**。该模块等待参与的 Facebook 进程退出，然后再重新打开 Facebook。关闭或重新创建设置应用程序后，待处理的更改仍然存在；重新启动期间所做的编辑仍悬而未决。

如果无法确认重新启动，则更改仍处于待定状态。打开 Facebook 并重试，或者在重新打开之前手动强制停止 Facebook。

## 账户备份

**导出** 将 Facebook 的实时身份验证/登录会话文件作为“FBAR-Session-*.json”保存到“Download/FacebookAppAdsRemover”。单独捕获的令牌和 cookie 不会添加到导出中。

**导入最新**恢复最新的备份。 **从文件导入**允许您选择备份，包括从另一台设备复制的备份。成功导入后，返回主页并点击**应用更改**。

备份包含登录凭据，并且可以授予对您帐户的访问权限。将其保密，并且不要将其附加到问题报告中。

## 诊断

使用 **保存报告** 或 **共享报告** 之前打开 Facebook。报告包含经过清理的配置和挂钩发现诊断，不包括原始活动和媒体负载。待处理的请求和私人缓存的报告可以在设置重新创建后保留下来，包括在系统保存选择器打开时。

报告问题时，请提供您的 Facebook 版本、框架版本、受影响的功能和诊断报告。

## 隐藏启动器图标

**模块**页面可以隐藏启动器图标。您仍然可以从 Xposed 管理器的模块列表中重新打开设置。隐藏图标并不会禁用 Facebook 的钩子。

在 Pixel Launcher 上，搜索模块仍然可以显示应用程序信息条目，即使其抽屉图标被隐藏。

## 支持和来源

- [报告问题或请求功能](https://github.com/Loukious/FacebookAppAdsRemover/issues)
- [源代码和技术文档](https://github.com/Loukious/FacebookAppAdsRemover)
- [支持开发](https://buymeacoffee.com/loukious)

该存储库托管模块列表和发布 APK。开发源保存在链接源存储库中。
